verses.original: Διαμαρτύρομαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ μέλλοντος κρίνειν ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς καὶ αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐπιφάνειαν καὶ αὐτοῦ τὴν βασιλείαν
verses.transliteration: Diamartyromai enōpion tou Theou kai Christou Iēsou tou mellontos krinein zōntas kai nekrous kai autou tēn epiphaneian kai autou tēn basileian
verses.literal: I charge [you] in the presence - of God and of Christ Jesus who will judge [the] living and [the] dead and [in view] of His - appearing and His - kingdom

verses.original: κήρυξον τὸν λόγον ἐπίστηθι εὐκαίρως ἀκαίρως ἔλεγξον ἐπιτίμησον παρακάλεσον ἐν πάσῃ μακροθυμίᾳ καὶ διδαχῇ
verses.transliteration: kēryxon ton logon epistēthi eukairōs akairōs elenxon epitimēson parakaleson en pasē makrothymia kai didachē
verses.literal: Preach the word be prepared in season [and] out of season reprove rebuke [and] encourage with every [ form of] patient - instruction

verses.original: γὰρ καιρὸς Ἔσται ὅτε οὐκ ἀνέξονται τῆς ὑγιαινούσης διδασκαλίας ἀλλὰ κνηθόμενοι τὴν ἀκοήν ἐπισωρεύσουσιν ἑαυτοῖς διδασκάλους κατὰ τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας
verses.transliteration: gar kairos Estai hote ouk anexontai tēs hygiainousēs didaskalias alla knēthomenoi tēn akoēn episōreusousin heautois didaskalous kata tas idias epithymias
verses.literal: For [the] time will come when vvv men will not tolerate - sound doctrine but with itching - ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit [their] own desires

verses.original: καὶ ἀποστρέψουσιν τὴν ἀκοὴν ἀπὸ μὲν τῆς ἀληθείας δὲ ἐκτραπήσονται ἐπὶ τοὺς μύθους
verses.transliteration: kai apostrepsousin tēn akoēn apo men tēs alētheias de ektrapēsontai epi tous mythous
verses.literal: [So] they will turn [their] ears {away} from - the truth and turn aside to - myths

verses.original: δὲ Σὺ νῆφε ἐν πᾶσιν κακοπάθησον ποίησον ἔργον εὐαγγελιστοῦ πληροφόρησον σου τὴν διακονίαν
verses.transliteration: de Sy nēphe en pasin kakopathēson poiēson ergon euangelistou plērophorēson sou tēn diakonian
verses.literal: But you be sober in all things endure hardship do [the] work of an evangelist fulfill your - ministry

verses.original: γὰρ Ἐγὼ ἤδη σπένδομαι καὶ ὁ καιρὸς τῆς μου ἀναλύσεώς ἐφέστηκεν
verses.transliteration: gar Egō ēdē spendomai kai ho kairos tēs mou analyseōs ephestēken
verses.literal: For I {am} already being poured out like a drink offering and the time of my departure is at hand

verses.original: ἠγώνισμαι τὸν καλὸν ἀγῶνα τετέλεκα τὸν δρόμον τετήρηκα τὴν πίστιν
verses.transliteration: ēgōnismai ton kalon agōna teteleka ton dromon tetērēka tēn pistin
verses.literal: I have fought the good fight I have finished the race I have kept the faith

verses.original: λοιπὸν ἀπόκειταί μοι ὁ στέφανος τῆς δικαιοσύνης ὃν ὁ κύριος ὁ δίκαιος κριτής ἀποδώσει μοι ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ δὲ οὐ μόνον ἐμοὶ ἀλλὰ καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ἠγαπηκόσι αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐπιφάνειαν
verses.transliteration: loipon apokeitai moi ho stephanos tēs dikaiosynēs hon ho kyrios ho dikaios kritēs apodōsei moi en ekeinē tē hēmera de ou monon emoi alla kai pasi tois ēgapēkosi autou tēn epiphaneian
verses.literal: From now on there is laid up for me the crown - of righteousness which the Lord the righteous Judge will award to me on that - day and not only to me but . . . to all who crave His - appearing

verses.original: Σπούδασον ἐλθεῖν πρός με ταχέως
verses.transliteration: Spoudason elthein pros me tacheōs
verses.literal: Make every effort to come to me quickly

verses.original: γάρ Δημᾶς ἀγαπήσας τὸν νῦν αἰῶνα ἐγκατέλιπεν με καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς Θεσσαλονίκην Κρήσκης εἰς Γαλατίαν Τίτος εἰς Δαλματίαν
verses.transliteration: gar Dēmas agapēsas ton nyn aiōna enkatelipen me kai eporeuthē eis Thessalonikēn Krēskēs eis Galatian Titos eis Dalmatian
verses.literal: because Demas in his love of - this [world] has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica Crescens [has gone] to Galatia [and] Titus to Dalmatia

verses.original: μόνος Λουκᾶς ἐστιν μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἀναλαβὼν Μᾶρκον ἄγε μετὰ σεαυτοῦ γάρ ἔστιν εὔχρηστος μοι εἰς διακονίαν
verses.transliteration: monos Loukas estin met’ emou analabōn Markon age meta seautou gar estin euchrēstos moi eis diakonian
verses.literal: Only Luke is with me Get Mark [and] bring [him] with you because he is useful to me in [the] ministry

verses.original: Τυχικὸν δὲ ἀπέστειλα εἰς Ἔφεσον
verses.transliteration: Tychikon de apesteila eis Epheson
verses.literal: Tychicus however I have sent to Ephesus

verses.original: ἐρχόμενος φέρε τὸν φαιλόνην ὃν ἀπέλιπον παρὰ Κάρπῳ ἐν Τρῳάδι καὶ τὰ βιβλία μάλιστα τὰς μεμβράνας
verses.transliteration: erchomenos phere ton phailonēn hon apelipon para Karpō en Trōadi kai ta biblia malista tas membranas
verses.literal: When you come bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas and [my] scrolls especially the parchments

verses.original: Ἀλέξανδρος ὁ χαλκεὺς ἐνεδείξατο πολλά κακὰ μοι ὁ Κύριος ἀποδώσει αὐτῷ κατὰ αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα
verses.transliteration: Alexandros ho chalkeus enedeixato polla kaka moi ho Kyrios apodōsei autō kata autou ta erga
verses.literal: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me The Lord will repay him according to his - deeds

verses.original: σὺ καὶ φυλάσσου ὃν γὰρ λίαν ἀντέστη ἡμετέροις τοῖς λόγοις
verses.transliteration: sy kai phylassou hon gar lian antestē hēmeterois tois logois
verses.literal: You too should beware of [him] for vvv he has vigorously opposed our - message

verses.original: Ἐν μου πρώτῃ τῇ ἀπολογίᾳ οὐδείς παρεγένετο μοι ἀλλὰ πάντες ἐγκατέλιπον με μὴ λογισθείη αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: En mou prōtē tē apologia oudeis paregeneto moi alla pantes enkatelipon me mē logistheiē autois
verses.literal: At my first - defense no one stood with me but everyone deserted me vvv May it not be charged against them

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Κύριός παρέστη μοι καὶ ἐνεδυνάμωσέν με ἵνα δι’ ἐμοῦ τὸ κήρυγμα πληροφορηθῇ καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἀκούσωσιν καὶ ἐρρύσθην ἐκ στόματος λέοντος
verses.transliteration: de ho Kyrios parestē moi kai enedynamōsen me hina di’ emou to kērygma plērophorēthē kai panta ta ethnē akousōsin kai errysthēn ek stomatos leontos
verses.literal: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles would hear [it] [So] I was delivered from [the] mouth of the lion

verses.original: ὁ Κύριος ῥύσεταί με ἀπὸ παντὸς πονηροῦ ἔργου καὶ σώσει εἰς αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐπουράνιον τὴν βασιλείαν ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: ho Kyrios rhysetai me apo pantos ponērou ergou kai sōsei eis autou tēn epouranion tēn basileian hō hē doxa eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: [And] the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring [me] safely into His - heavenly - kingdom To Him [be] the glory vvv vvv forever [and] ever Amen

verses.original: Ἄσπασαι Πρίσκαν καὶ Ἀκύλαν καὶ τὸν οἶκον Ὀνησιφόρου
verses.transliteration: Aspasai Priskan kai Akylan kai ton oikon Onēsiphorou
verses.literal: Greet Prisca and Aquila as well as the household of Onesiphorus

verses.original: Ἔραστος ἔμεινεν ἐν Κορίνθῳ δὲ Τρόφιμον ἀπέλιπον ἀσθενοῦντα ἐν Μιλήτῳ
verses.transliteration: Erastos emeinen en Korinthō de Trophimon apelipon asthenounta en Milētō
verses.literal: Erastus has remained at Corinth and Trophimus I left sick in Miletus

verses.original: Σπούδασον ἐλθεῖν πρὸ χειμῶνος Εὔβουλος Ἀσπάζεταί σε καὶ Πούδης καὶ Λίνος καὶ Κλαυδία καὶ πάντες οἱ ἀδελφοὶ
verses.transliteration: Spoudason elthein pro cheimōnos Euboulos Aspazetai se kai Poudēs kai Linos kai Klaudia kai pantes hoi adelphoi
verses.literal: Make every effort to come [ to me ] before winter Eubulus sends you greetings . . . as do Pudens - Linus - Claudia and all the brothers

verses.original: Ὁ Κύριος μετὰ σου τοῦ πνεύματός ἡ χάρις μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ho Kyrios meta sou tou pneumatos hē charis meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: The Lord [be] with your - spirit - Grace [be] with you all
